# Vardy Watch

> Track Premier League goal-scoring streaks against Jamie Vardy's 11-game record.

## Pages

- [Vardy Watch](https://vardywatch.com/): Current active scoring streaks, season bests, historical season leaders, and scoring-streak methodology.
- [Weekly previews](https://vardywatch.com/blog/): Latest previews and links to all editions.
- [Weekly preview archive](https://vardywatch.com/blog/archive.html): Browse previous editions.
- [Scoring-streak methodology](https://vardywatch.com/blog/methodology.html): Definitions and publication approach.

## Content

- [Full site content](https://vardywatch.com/llms-full.txt): Definitions and data methodology for the dashboard.
- [Eight in sight? Haaland leads the chase, but nobody gets a free pass](https://vardywatch.com/blog/2026-10-29-early-preview.html): Early preview for 29 October-2 November 2026; source freshness is unverified and projected streaks are conditional.
